While the source is a binary blob and thus not independently verifiable, this is an inherent limitation of the upstream distribution model, not a sign of malicious intent in the AUR packaging. The file itself contains no active code and cannot perform any actions during parsing. Therefore, no supply-chain attack vectors are introduced by this `.SRCINFO` file.
